description.narrative: This project, implemented within the framework of the second phase of the UN Highlands Joint Programme, which this project is kick-starting, aims to build resilience and stability across four target Highlands provinces of Papua New Guinea (PNG) by addressing the interconnected challenges of climate-induced risks, conflict, and community vulnerability in a number of identified hot spots within those provinces.
